notes: The calendar no longer draws a box over the dates you focused on. Chess pieces are drawn now rather than borrowed from whatever font the phone has, so both sides can be seen on every square. In Spymaster a long word gets smaller instead of breaking in half, and the board fills the width on the spymaster's screen as well. The spiders on the walls have their feet on them. Your level runs much further: the same shelf is spread over forty-five levels instead of twelve, so something keeps opening as the hours add up, and nothing takes longer to earn than it did. A room holds up to twelve people.
